candidates.change_summary: Change the assert condition from > to >= so it no longer rejects overflow that would wrap around, altering balances behavior.
Remove the assert statement entirely, so deposits that overflow are allowed and change the resulting balance.
Change the balance update to assign msg.value instead of adding, making balance overwrite previous value.
Delete the balance update statement, so deposited Ether is recorded as zero balance.
Remove the require statement that checks amount <= balances[msg.sender]
Remove the balance deduction after transfer, allowing double spending
Replace transfer with a call that sends 0 ETH instead of amount
Move balance deduction before the transfer call
Replace transfer of entire balance with transfer of zero ether.
Replace the recipient of the transfer with the zero address.
Replace the transfer of entire balance with a transfer of 1 wei.
Delete the transfer statement so no ether is sent.
Replace msg.sender check with true, removing the access control.
Delete the require statement so anyone can call migrateTo.
